args.message: For each region, I added up every order's amount minus the discount of the customer who placed it. I grouped by the customer's region name. Orders whose customer has no known region are in the null row (10 orders, 627.83). I left out orders whose customer ID doesn't match any customer record. No matched customer has a missing discount, so no orders were dropped for that reason.
